chunks: Hishām ibn al-Muthannā narrated from Sadīr, from Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said to him:
"Begin with Mecca and conclude with us."

key_terms.أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ: Abū Jaʿfar, the Imam Muḥammad al-Bāqir عليه السلام.
key_terms.بِمَكَّةَ: With Mecca, the sacred sanctuary and destination of pilgrimage.
key_terms.بِنَا: With us, referring to the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام.

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith mean by beginning with Mecca and concluding with the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith instructs believers to begin with Mecca and to conclude with the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام. It reflects the spiritual connection between the sacred sanctuary and the divinely guided household in devotional practice and visitation.
